botcomponent.description: Resolve security roles from the standard Dataverse role table. Use it to turn the GUID in _faf001_requiredrole_value into a role name and description, and to find a role by its actual name supplied by the user. Filter with roleid eq <guid>; do not assume a predefined role name. Useful columns: roleid, name, description, _businessunitid_value. A required role identifies a task routing capability rather than a named person; it does not by itself prove that the caller can act. Always pass $select and $top.
botcomponent.name: List security role rows
